title: Puttering Pebble-Puffer
statement: Drifting through warm, amber-lit water and forests of feathery green eelgrass, this round little puffer spends every afternoon sorting smooth river pebbles and frosted sea glass into tiny, concentric spirals. Whenever a stray bubble scatters its careful work, it puffs its cheeks in mild surprise and happily begins arranging a brand-new pattern from scratch.
